hints.content:
We can turn the rule into numbers and math symbols:

Rule: To find $\goldD y \maroonD{\text{ multiply}}$ $\blueD x $ $\maroonD{\text{by } 2}$ then $\greenD{\text{add }4}$.

$\blueD x \maroonD{\times 2} \greenD{+4}= \goldD y$

Now we can use the rule to  complete the  table: 

$x$ | |$y$ 
:-: | :-: 
$\blueD0$ |  $\blueD 0 \maroonD{\times 2} \greenD{+4}=  \goldD4\\$   | $\goldD4$
$\blueD1$ |  $\blueD 1\maroonD{\times 2}\greenD{+4}=  \goldD6\\$      | $\goldD6$
$\blueD2$ | $\blueD 2\maroonD{\times 2}\greenD{+4}  =  \goldD8\\$   |$\goldD8$
Each ordered pair in the table represents a point on a graph. We need to see which graph contains the points $(0, 4), (1, 6)$, and $(2, 8)$.

Here is the completed table and the graph that shows the points from the table:

$x$ | $y$ 
:-: | :-: 
$0$ |  $4$
$1$ |  $6$
$2$ |  $8$




[[☃ image 1]]
